    feed = RSS::Parser.parse(feed_content, false)

    items = if feed.respond_to?(:items)

              feed.entries

          source: source_name
        }
      end
    end

      fetched_at: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
      retrieval_tool: "rss_feed_parser",
      retrieval_mode: "live",

    }
  end
